parsed.explanation: The counterexample is valid. Replacing a column of height 2d by columns of heights d/2 and 3d/2 changes the parity of N(t) on (0,d/2) (and also on (3d/2,2d)), so the claimed one-directional interchange is false. The subsequent induction for lemma (ii) relies on that assertion and is not independently justified. Section 3 merely invokes lemma (ii), and the reference to an external file cannot repair the proof presented here. Establishing the universal lower bound therefore requires a corrected substantive argument, not a symbolic or one-sentence edit.
